_comment: Config for evaluate_endomapper.py / visualize_endomapper.py, matching the real downloaded EndoMapper layout under datasets/EndoMapper/{pseudoGT,colmap_benchmark_frames}/<patient_id>/<subseq_id>/.
_sequences_comment: null = auto-discover every "<patient_id>/<subseq_id>" that has both a COLMAP model and a frames dir (161 as of the first download batch, across 8 patients). Or give an explicit list, e.g. ["00033/13", "00034/14"].
_colmap_root_comment: data_root/colmap_root/<patient_id>/<subseq_id>/ holds the COLMAP reconstruction (cameras/images/points3D, under colmap_model_subdir as .bin, or directly as sibling .txt files).
_frames_root_comment: data_root/frames_root/<patient_id>/<subseq_id>/ holds the frame PNGs COLMAP's images.txt/bin NAME field refers to directly (no extra subdirectory prefix).
_colmap_model_subdir_comment: COLMAP's binary export lives one level deeper than the text export, in a numbered model directory (always "0" for every sequence seen so far). Falls back to the parent directory's .txt files if "0" isn't a valid model.
_min_points_per_frame_comment: Frames with fewer valid sparse points than this are skipped in evaluate_endomapper.py and flagged in visualize_endomapper.py's health summary.
_cameras_comment: EndoMapper cameras are OPENCV_FISHEYE. get_sparse_depth() samples COLMAP's actual detected keypoint pixels (not a re-projection through the distortion model), so this works correctly as-is.
_undistortion_comment: NOTE: SHADeS/SHADeS++ were trained on UNDISTORTED C3VD/Hyper-Kvasir frames (see prepare_data/README.md). These EndoMapper frames are raw fisheye-distorted video -- there is a train/eval domain gap until they're undistorted the same way before being fed to the model. Not handled yet; flag if you want this added (cv2.fisheye.* using each sequence's own OPENCV_FISHEYE params, already parsed by datasets/colmap_utils.py).
